description: Find Eased components for a need, e.g. "loading state", "tooltip", "drag to adjust a number" or "tabs with a sliding indicator". Matches title, slug, interaction verb, description and README docs, best match first; pass industry to keep to one (e.g. "a swap UI" for crypto). Follow up with get_component for docs and source.

industry.description: Only components tagged for this industry: ai (AI agents), devtools (developer tools), finance (fintech and FX), crypto (crypto), saas (SaaS analytics), legal (legal tech), ecommerce (e-commerce), real-estate (real estate and CRE), health (health tech), hr (HR and recruiting), education (edtech), travel (travel and booking), media (creator tools). Leave out for every industry.

query.description: What the component should be or do, in a few words.

name: search_components
title: Search Eased components
